recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further edits would only restate guidance that is already present; any future change to the boundary between CodeSystem filters and $lookup properties should be handled as a separate terminology work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-23787 is a Published FHIR-core Vocab change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to clarify that ValueSet compose filters can use property/filter name code with op=regex, add the corresponding CodeSystem filters table row with server-determined regex flavor, and update the terminology service Standard Properties table to Standard $lookup Properties with corrected name/display/designation/lang.X wording.
initial_application: No prior AutoFHIR reconcile commit for FHIR-23787 was present on the combined branch. Git history shows 43c2e8c78373d49b328cd5fc7698c35c8834d4dc directly applied the terminology-service.html table changes for FHIR-23787, while f43f55953f3d55407718d24c676f2471597f9deb added the CodeSystem code/regex filter row even though that commit was titled for FHIR-39262.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread asked how to use regex filtering against concept codes and raised the regex flavor question. The 2023-02-06 Vocab minutes clarify the work-group intent: code is a filter name for ValueSet.compose.include.filter.property rather than a new standard $lookup concept property, and regex flavor is determined by the server. Source build-scope checks show CodeSystem is an active resource and terminology-service.html is linked from the built hierarchy/module pages.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml already has the code / regex / [string] filters row with the requested definition and note, and source/terminology-service.html already has the Standard $lookup Properties heading, concept-oriented display/designation text, lang.X parenthesis correction, and removal of the deprecated system sentence from name.

related_jiras.note: The historical commit that added the FHIR-23787 code/regex row was titled for this separate CodeSystem hierarchy issue; FHIR-39262 itself was not decided here.
